entities.name: PDU session reactivation result
entities.description: Information element included in messages when certain conditions regarding uplink data status or allowed PDU session status are met.

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: Information element that indicates the status of uplink data.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: Information element that indicates the status of allowed PDU sessions.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message that may contain Uplink data status IE or Allowed PDU session status IE.

entities.name: Uplink data status IE included
entities.description: Condition where the Uplink data status IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status IE included
entities.description: Condition where the Allowed PDU session status IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and at least one PDU session can have user-plane resources re-established over 3GPP access.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Uplink data status IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Allowed PDU session status IE.
Inclusion of PDU session reactivation result IE is guarded by the condition that Uplink data status IE is included.
Inclusion of PDU session reactivation result IE is guarded by the condition that Allowed PDU session status IE is included and at least one PDU session can be re-established over 3GPP access.
